head: d68c2dc6b80c400b8ce9b07837f7a14cabb5d616

assertionMapping.evidence: 11 HTTP result records: expected setup pages, health response, missing-service 503s and settings 307 redirects.
assertionMapping.boundedDetails: Settings Location is checked with and without clientId query. Assertions check nosniff, DENY, and absent x-powered-by. Referrer-Policy exists in source but is not directly asserted by this probe. No live authorization or native service call is accepted.

assertionMapping.facet: Actual header Portfolio link and scoped styles across viewport/theme
assertionMapping.evidence: 4 theme/viewport records and 4 visually reviewed PNGs.
assertionMapping.boundedDetails: Actual Portfolio header Link is clicked from Meri at 1440 and 390; checks canonical / href, setup heading, loaded 77x26 wordmark, dark inversion, one Portfolio marker, 14px body, expected background, no document overflow, same document, and restored Meri computed body styles on return. clientNavigation means client-side routing, not selected-client/tenant authority verification.

Runs only at 1440x1040. Actual Modules and Account settings links, Connection setup heading, absence of Portfolio marker in Modules, /settings/personal URL, back to /modules and forward to settings, same-document sentinel. No screenshots capture Meri, Modules or Settings destination appearance; no mobile full-history claim.

assertionMapping.facet: Default Portfolio root and runtime-config eligibility
assertionMapping.evidence: Successful runner plus preview-root-smoke.json and source-bound exit receipt.
assertionMapping.boundedDetails: 9 shared entry routes must be absent from prerender manifest; runner clears keys/service origins. Separate CAPIRO_DEFAULT_PRODUCT=portfolio root receives 200 and setup content. Meri itself remains the explicitly labeled disconnected synthetic product fixture; no injected browser identity or intercepted service response is used.
No pageerror during these flows; not a blanket console/network/performance or crash-free application claim.

supported: Source provides html lang=en, main landmark, h1 setup heading, explanatory paragraph, semantic ul/li and Capiro image alternative text.
Product modes navigation and destination links have accessible names; role/name locators successfully identify clicked controls in the producer run.
All captured setup text and logo appear legible in light/dark; both phone captures show wrapped content without visible clipping.
Producer asserts no horizontal document overflow for the four Portfolio fallback states.
notEstablished: No keyboard-only Tab order, activation, focus-return/history focus or visible focus capture.
No axe or equivalent whole-page accessibility audit, screen-reader session, accessible-tree snapshot or formal all-element contrast measurement.
No zoom/reflow at 200/400%, forced colors, reduced motion, localization or other browser/device coverage.
No signed-in forms/dialogs, loaded data tables, mobile Modules/Settings history or authenticated current-client replacement accessibility.

importantCoverageBoundaries: Only the Portfolio configuration-required fallback is captured.
Full mode history tested at desktop width; mobile has Portfolio header entry/return only.
clientNavigation record denotes client-side router behavior, not client identity/authority.
No live sign-in, native service, provider, Meri runtime or data durability acceptance.
No Figma or full accessibility acceptance.
